objects.taxonomy_description: Fabric bag with two parallel shoulder straps for carrying on the back. The main compartment is a rectangular or rounded pouch (30-55 cm tall) made of nylon, canvas, or polyester with a zipper or drawstring closure. External features include side pockets, front organizer pockets, and compression straps. The back panel has padded shoulder straps that converge at the top and a reinforced grab handle. Materials range from smooth synthetic fabric to textured canvas. Colors vary widely. The bag exhibits bilateral symmetry with straps positioned symmetrically on the back panel.

objects.taxonomy_description: 长颈鹿属于偶蹄目长颈鹿科，是现存最高的陆生哺乳动物，以其极长的颈部和独特的骨皮角为显著特征。

diagnostic_checkpoints.颈部: 拥有极度延长的颈部，长度显著超过身体其他部分，用于高处取食。
diagnostic_checkpoints.头部: 头顶具有一对或多对被皮肤和毛发覆盖的骨质突起（骨皮角），而非分叉的骨质鹿角或中空牛角。
diagnostic_checkpoints.四肢: 四肢修长且比例均匀，前肢通常略长于后肢，支撑高大的身躯。
diagnostic_checkpoints.体态: 整体轮廓呈现明显的前高后低倾斜姿态，肩部隆起高于臀部。

objects.taxonomy_description: Fleet equine mammal measuring 120-150 cm at withers with distinctive black-and-white striped coat pattern. Stripes unique to each individual, extending across body, legs, and mane. Head elongated with large dark eyes and mobile ears. Neck arched with erect bristly mane. Body robust and muscular. Legs long and slender terminating in single dark hooves. Tail long with black tufted hair. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse body hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. African equine with herd behavior. Stripes serve as camouflage and fly deterrent.
